text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't even come close! How is<n>she so much
better than me?!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, McQueen... We were hoping for<n>so long that
one of you would emerge<n>victorious today, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I know. I never would've expected<n>this. But still,
moping won't help...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but next time,<n>the glory's
mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure McQueen feels just the<n>same! I
know she's going to do her<n>best to live up to all
your<n>expectations! And that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the<n>Mejiro family!
And at the Takarazuka<n>Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will
show you<n>that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That's right! I'll always be<n>rooting for you,
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And here I was feeling all sorry for<n>myself... I
didn't even think about my<n>fans.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But Ryan's different. She heard her<n>fans' voices
and put them at ease<n>right away.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Now that's someone who's lived<n>shouldering
expectations. That's<n>what separates me and her...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! At the<n>Takarazuka Kinen,
that's gonna be<n>me!
